thesis: The episode introduces Jonathan Tepper, founder of Variant Perception, and discusses his upbringing as the son of Presbyterian missionaries who established drug rehabilitation centers in Spain run by addicts themselves. The conversation also covers Tepper's early realization of foreign exchange impacts on purchasing power, illustrated by his experience buying fewer Big Macs in Madrid compared to the United States.
